direction: base calendar.read API is shipped; C-01/C-02/C-03 cooperation additions and the Task Horizon consumer remain pending acceptance
providerEvidenceBaseline: siyuan-checkin tag v18.17.6; this draft does not declare new runtime descriptor fields or production cooperation readiness

providerReadiness.proposedGate: after agreement and provider delivery, describe().integrationContracts.taskHorizonCalendar === 1 / taskHorizonCompletion === 1, or an equivalent frozen readiness marker; neither marker exists in v18.17.6

consumes.projectionPrivacy: pure data snapshot: no notes, no attachments, no externalRef

consumerRules: protocol/version>=5/calendar.read negotiation proves only the base API, not cooperation readiness; do not enable production cooperation until the proposed readiness gate, dual-side fixtures, and real-host acceptance are complete

capture the current window.siyuanCheckin; after await capturedApi.whenReady(), require ready === true, window.siyuanCheckin === capturedApi, and capturedApi.isReady() === true before reads or subscriptions; isReady only reflects its own host and does not prove that the reference is still current; repeat the current-reference check after any later await
getCalendarProjection is synchronous and bounded: validate the half-open range, debounce/coalesce refresh events, and do not claim timeout or AbortSignal can interrupt the provider call

coalesce and re-read on checkin:item-created, checkin:item-updated, checkin:item-deleted, checkin:item-archived, checkin:event-recorded, checkin:event-deleted, or checkin:analytics-updated; ignore only suggestion-workflow-updated for this projection
degrade to hidden layer on missing plugin, missing capability, unload, or error; clear stale cached projection and refresh on recovery
legacy v4-only consumers must not surface hidden items from stale caches: keep legacy aggregate or hide the fine-grained layer

display-only: never writes task state back from the projection; new task completion cooperation MUST use v5 recordEventsBatch even for one entry, never fallback to recordEvent, with taskhorizon:<blockId>:<localDate> and the original explicit occurredAt/unit/value retained in a consumer-owned durable queue; the write setting is independent of the visibility switch; W-03 dedicated validation and W-06 consumer queue/reload acceptance remain pending

host-level batch Promise rejection means no reliable success receipt and may occur after facts are durable: keep original identities for confirmation/retry; do not turn it into per-entry kind=rejected, which means that entry failed structural validation and is not written

current batch reason not-scheduled refers only to the item's creation/archive availability period, not every non-scheduled weekday/interval; W-03 still needs the Task Horizon count+daily+atLeast and SKIP rules plus strict occurredAt calendar validation, since Date.parse may normalize impossible month-days or 24:00
acceptance: hidden items absent from every legacy consumption path
Task Horizon missing/reload/upgrade leaves siyuan-checkin unaffected
